steps.title: Research and plan project structure
steps.description:
Analyze the requirements and plan the implementation approach:
- Verify the current working directory and available tools
- Research best practices for Vite + React + TypeScript setup
- Determine the project structure (components, types, styling approach)
- Identify the specific commands needed to scaffold the project
- Plan the component architecture (single component vs. multiple components)
- Define the TypeScript interfaces for Todo items
- Document the state management approach (useState)
- List all dependencies that will be needed
- Create a clear implementation plan for subsequent steps

Deliverables:
- Clear understanding of project structure
- List of commands to execute
- Component architecture design
- TypeScript type definitions planned

steps.title: Initialize Vite project with React and TypeScript
steps.description:
Set up the project scaffolding:
- Create a new Vite project using 'npm create vite@latest' with React + TypeScript template
- Navigate into the project directory
- Install dependencies using 'npm install'
- Verify the initial build works with 'npm run build'
- Remove boilerplate files (App.css content, default components)
- Initialize git repository with 'git init'
- Create initial commit with scaffolded project

Validation:
- Project builds successfully without errors
- Dev server can start (npm run dev)
- Git repository initialized
- Clean working directory after initial commit

steps.title: Implement Todo component with core functionality
steps.description:
Build the main Todo application component:
- Create TypeScript interface for Todo items (id, text, completed)
- Implement App.tsx with useState to manage todo list state
- Add form/input for adding new todos
- Implement addTodo function to add items to the list
- Create todo list rendering with map function
- Implement toggleComplete function to mark todos as done
- Implement deleteTodo function to remove items
- Add basic styling (CSS modules or inline styles) for:
  - Input field and add button
  - Todo list items
  - Complete/delete buttons
  - Strike-through for completed items
- Ensure proper key props on list items
- Add basic form validation (non-empty todos)

Validation:
- Can add new todo items
- Can mark todos as complete (visual indicator)
- Can delete todos
- UI is functional and presentable

steps.title: Build, test, and finalize with git commit
steps.description:
Validate the complete application and finalize:
- Run 'npm run build' to ensure production build works
- Verify no TypeScript compiler errors
- Check for any linter warnings with 'npm run lint' (if available)
- Manually test all functionality:
  - Add multiple todo items
  - Toggle completion status on items
  - Delete items from the list
  - Test edge cases (empty input, etc.)
- Review code for readability and conventions
- Stage all changes with 'git add .'
- Create commit with message describing the Todo app implementation
- Run 'git status' to verify clean working directory
- Generate final summary of deliverables

Validation:
- Build completes without errors or warnings
- All functionality works as specified
- Git shows clean status after commit
- Application meets all Definition of Done criteria
